title: A Polyhedral Study on Unit Commitment with a Single Type of Binary Variables
summary: Efficient power production scheduling is a crucial concern for power system operators aiming to minimize operational costs. Previous mixed-integer linear programming formulations for unit commitment (UC) problems have primarily used two or three types of binary variables. The investigation of strong formulations with a single type of binary variables has been limited, as it is believed to be challenging to derive strong valid inequalities using fewer binary variables, and the reduction of the number of binary variables is often accompanied by a compromise in tightness.
